changelog:
This one installs normally — no uninstall needed.

FIXES
Player sign-in: the keyboard's Next, Done or Enter, and the remote's Play, move from Username to Password and on to Sign In.
Support and Device Cleaner: the highlight is a bright gold ring on every button, movement goes row by row instead of jumping, and lists no longer jolt when they scroll.
Home: the Dashboard button's highlight is gold instead of black.
Device Cleaner on Fire TV: no Accessibility switch needed. Leftover files and background apps clear in one press, and app caches open on Fire TV's own app page, one app at a time.
Everything in 1.7.2 is included.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.3 fixes the keyboard's Next key on the Player sign-in, makes the highlight bright and steady in Support and the Device Cleaner, gives the Home Dashboard button a gold highlight, and adds a Fire TV path for the Device Cleaner. Installs normally — no reinstall.
